premises.text: Customized instant manicures are a hassle for girls like Kendall
premises.evidence_span: But for Kendall and her girlfriends, getting a customized instant manicure is a hassle.

premises.text: Nail salons are inconvenient and pricey
premises.evidence_span: Going to a nail salon is extremely inconvenient. It's also pretty pricey.

premises.text: The Nailbot can print custom instant nail art directly onto fingernails
premises.evidence_span: We invented the Nailbot. The Nailbot prints custom instant nail art directly onto your fingernail using your smartphone.

premises.text: The Nailbot uses safe formulations for cosmetic use
premises.evidence_span: The formulations in the cartridge will be safe for cosmetic use when we ship the Nailbot commercially.

premises.text: The Nailbot can print images in just a few seconds
premises.evidence_span: It's printing in just a few seconds.

premises.text: There is a significant market of tween and teen girls who regularly decorate their nails
premises.evidence_span: they are 21 million girls strong in the United States, 92% of which decorate their nails regularly.

premises.text: An augmented reality app can enhance the Nailbot experience
premises.evidence_span: we developed an augmented reality app where they can use the back-facing camera on their smartphone and superimpose images of their best friends, emojis, anything else from our app directly onto their fingernail.

premises.text: The nail services and nail care industry is a $15 billion market globally
premises.evidence_span: the nail services and the nail care industry is $15 billion globally.

value.text: Girls can express themselves creatively through customized nail art
value.evidence_span: we're creating an art marketplace for those to creatively express themselves with applications well beyond fingernail printing and painting.

notes: Traction metrics and personal backgrounds excluded as irrelevant.
